Create containers

Source: R/container.R
loro_text.Rd

These functions create a container that does not yet belong to a document. Store it in a map or list, the way a nested list is built in R, and it becomes part of that document:

note = doc_map(doc, "note")
note$items = loro_list("milk", "eggs")
note$body = loro_text("Buy before Friday")

Containers nest, so loro_map(title = "Notes", tags = loro_list("a")) builds a map holding a list, and all of it is added in one step when it is stored. Wherever a value can be stored (map_set(), $<- and [[<- on a map, list_insert(), list_push(), list_set(), and [[<- on a list), a new container can be given instead.

A new container can be edited with the usual functions before it is stored. Storing it adds a copy of its contents to the document, and from then on the handle, and any handle to a container nested in it, refers to the container in the document, so later edits through it are part of the document's history and sync like any other.

A container can be stored only once. Storing a handle to a container that is already in a document is an error, except for assigning a child back to the key it was read from (as in map$child$key = value), which does nothing.

The objects returned are the handle classes described in containers.

Usage

loro_text(value = "", .ptr = NULL)

loro_map(..., .ptr = NULL)

loro_list(..., .ptr = NULL)

loro_movable_list(..., .ptr = NULL)

loro_counter(value = 0, .ptr = NULL)

loro_tree(.ptr = NULL)

Arguments

value

For loro_text(), the initial text, a string. For loro_counter(), the initial value, a number.

.ptr

For internal use.

...

For loro_map(), values named by key, as in map_set(). For loro_list() and loro_movable_list(), unnamed elements, as in list_push(). Values may themselves be new containers.

Value

A container handle that does not belong to a document until it is stored.

Examples

doc = loro_doc()
note = doc_map(doc, "note")

note$title = "Groceries"
note$items = loro_list("milk", "eggs")
note$body = loro_text("Buy before Friday")
str(doc_value(doc))
#> List of 1
#>  $ note:List of 3
#>   ..$ body : chr "Buy before Friday"
#>   ..$ items:List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr "milk"
#>   .. ..$ : chr "eggs"
#>   ..$ title: chr "Groceries"

list_push(note$items, "bread")
text_push(note$body, "!")

map_set(doc, todo = loro_list(
  loro_map(task = "write", done = TRUE),
  loro_map(task = "test", done = FALSE)
))
doc_get(doc, "map", "todo", 2, "task")
#> [1] "test"
